source: conversation: LRA/Order restructure request, redirected to LRA/Relation-first after relation-as-set correction
sibling_coordinator: docs/algebraic-structures-repair (separate ledger, by explicit choice, mirrors this one's shape)

workflow.coordinator_mode: main-thread, one subject at a time, strict tier order
success_gate: if both pass: commit on main (do not push unless asked)

items.subject: Relation
notes: The foundational item. Builds SetRelation: a genuine set of ordered pairs over LRA.Set.Interop.Providers.LRA.ZFC.ZFCSet, via HasPairing/OrderedPair + CartesianProductOf + HasSeparation (LRA/Set/Interface/CartesianProduct.lean; LRA/Set/Constructions/ZFCSet/Axioms/OrderedPair/Theorems.lean).

Second construction: Mathlib's own Set (Carrier x Carrier) -- NOT Rel (Mathlib's Rel is `alpha -> beta -> Prop`, same predicate shape as Endorelation, not a second genuinely-different representation).
Bridge theorem both directions: a SetRelation induces an Endorelation (fun x y => (x,y) in R), so existing predicate-shaped downstream code has a way to get one out.
See README.md's 'pushes past' note and DECISIONS.md R3 -- this is deliberately beyond the ambient-LRA_Set convention used elsewhere in the repo, not a regression to it.
Nothing in Order starts until this is done and reported back.

items.subject: Order/Constructions -> Interface/Combinators rename
notes: Pure mechanical rename, no math dependency -- can run in parallel with or-01.
LRA/Order/Constructions/{LexicographicOrder,ProductOrder,StrictNonStrictCorrespondence} -> LRA/Order/Interface/Combinators/{...}
Delete Order/Constructions.lean; fold its 3 imports into new Interface/Combinators.lean barrel.
Fix the one real external import: Order/Directedness/Directed/Theorems.lean (LRA.Order.Constructions.ProductOrder.Definition -> LRA.Order.Interface.Combinators.ProductOrder.Definition).
grep -rn 'Order\.Constructions\.' LRA afterward should return nothing outside the new tree.
See DECISIONS.md R7.

items.subject: PartialOrder / Poset
notes: Existing generic defs: Order/OrderedSets/{PartialOrder,Poset}/Definition.lean, Order/Laws/PartialOrder/Definition.lean (co-locate per R1/D3, not a separate sibling Laws/ folder).

Full model-theoretic writeup for this one already reviewed in the source conversation: L_<=, L-structure, T_Poset (reflexivity/antisymmetry/transitivity sentences), definability layer (Comp/Incomp/Cover/Minimal/Maximal/Bottom/Top/IsSup), substructure/homomorphism/embedding/isomorphism -- all in scope. Classification section (completeness/categoricity/stability/QE/finite-model-property) explicitly excluded, see README.

R10: check as-12 (sibling coordinator, done) -- algebra<->order equivalence already exists, more complete than either semilattice's own bridge, at LRA/Order/Interop/AlgebraicLattice.lean (moves to Constructions/AlgebraicStructures/ per R1). Do not duplicate.

items.subject: WellOrder + Ax_WellOrdered
notes: Existing: Order/OrderedSets/WellOrder/Definition.lean. LinearOrder + every nonempty subset has a least element.

Ax_WellOrdered attaches here once the ModelTheory exists -- see DECISIONS.md R4 for the naming exception. Statement shape: every carrier with a generic-Set membership structure admits some relation that well-orders it, asserted as a primitive axiom (classically equivalent to Choice, not derived from it).
Follow-on, not required for or-10 itself: a theorem (not a second axiom) showing Ax_WellOrdered restricted to the ZFC provider follows from ZFCSet's existing choiceFormula axiom.

items.subject: Morphisms
notes: Monotone/Antitone/OrderEmbedding/OrderIsomorphism -- properties of maps between two models of the same theory, not a new signature. See DECISIONS.md R8.

Directedness/* (Directed/Chain) folds in here too. Definability layer, not a new signature. See DECISIONS.md R8.
